settings.analyzer_settings.counts.context: Line under the username at the top of the Analyzer settings page, such as "1,251 followers · 342 following".

placeholders.followers: Runtime value: the follower count with its word, such as 1,251 followers. Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.
placeholders.following: Runtime value: the following count with its word, such as 342 following. Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.

settings.analyzer_settings.last_full.context: Label of a small tile at the top of the Analyzer settings page.

settings.analyzer_settings.today.context: Value of the Last full update tile for an update made today, such as "Today 08:37".

placeholders.time: Runtime value: a time of day. Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.

settings.analyzer_settings.never.context: Value of the Last full update tile when no full update was made yet.

settings.analyzer_settings.lists_known.context: Label of a small tile at the top of the Analyzer settings page: how many followers and following the Analyzer has saved.

settings.analyzer_settings.lists_value.context: Value of the Lists known tile: saved followers, then saved following, such as "1,248 followers · 342 following".

placeholders.followers: Runtime value: the number of saved followers with its word, from analyzer.dashboard.followers (such as "1,248 followers"). Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.
placeholders.following: Runtime value: the number of saved following with its word, from analyzer.dashboard.following (such as "342 following"). Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.

settings.analyzer_settings.not_yet.context: Value of the Lists known tile before the Analyzer has saved any list.

settings.history_settings.status.context: Status line at the top of the History settings page: saved items, the space they take and the day of the oldest one.

placeholders.count: A quantity, formatted in Instagram’s effective locale. Do not rename.
placeholders.size: Runtime value: a file size such as 18.7 MB. Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.
placeholders.date: Runtime value: a short date such as 12 Oct. Keep the name intact; move the placeholder to fit the translated sentence.

analyzer.dashboard.quick_needs_full.context: Line under the Update button, after the last update times, instead of the quick checks left today: there is no complete Followers list yet, so a quick check cannot run.

analyzer.update.needs_full.context: Short status next to the Quick check option of the update sheet when no full update made a complete Followers list yet; the reason is shown under it. Keep it short.

analyzer.tile.from_rows.context: Small note on the Mutual and You don’t follow back tiles before the Following list is known: the number only counts followers whose row showed the relationship (Follow back / Following).

settings.analyzer_quick_check.needs_full.context: Description of the Quick check row on the Analyzer settings page while no full update made a complete Followers list yet.

analyzer.not_back.known_since.context: Second line of a row, when MyInsta does not know when the user followed the account (it was already in Following at the first full update): the date MyInsta first saw it there. Must not read as a follow date.

placeholders.date: A short date such as “3 Nov”, already formatted for the locale.
